answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. By the grove of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the lantern of a task receipt, and the bridge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
